item.name: Royal Jelly

effects.title: Consume
effects.text:
Consumes all charges and grants a target allied unit a buff that provides +2.5 Health Regen and +1.25 Mana Regen per charge for 8s. 

If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

item.lore: To those who harvest olgru jelly, success serves more than mere profit--it's often the means to survival--for only the jelly itself can cure the ravages that follow a sting from the vigilant denizens of the giant hives.
